codingsev2: 2021 CodingSE defaults: 5 searchers, 4 regions, 2 goods per region, with mutation executed every transition. Encoding and target-order logic follow the 2021 implementation; fitness uses current services.
linucb_ring_setspriorityv2: Ring_SETSpriority (C4, w=8) with shared LinUCB. v2 design: every searcher-good pair picks one of h ring segments (span drawn with the 80/20 rule). Per-segment features: effective-difference buckets, inactive differences, span length, active ratio, the span's share of the worst target's neighbourhood cost and of total network cost (fitness v2's 0.7/0.3 terms), active energy; plus 7 shared features. Tiered reward per child: beats the pre-round best = 10, beats its parent = 1, else 0 (after DE-DDQN's R2).
linucb_ring_setsv2: Ring_SETS (SensorEncoding, w=8) with shared LinUCB. v2 design: every searcher-good pair picks one of h ring segments (span drawn with the 80/20 rule). Per-segment features: effective-difference buckets, inactive differences, span length, active ratio, the span's share of the worst target's neighbourhood cost and of total network cost (fitness v2's 0.7/0.3 terms), active energy; plus 7 shared features. Tiered reward per child: beats the pre-round best = 10, beats its parent = 1, else 0 (after DE-DDQN's R2).
rl_ring_sets: Ring_SETS (SensorEncoding, w=8) where every searcher-good pair picks its own segment with a frozen D3QN trained by train_rl_ring_sets.py. Observation = 8 features per segment (effective-difference buckets, inactive differences, span length, active ratio, contains the searcher's bottleneck sensor, active energy ratio) + 7 global features; the advantage head is shared across segments. Reward = normalized improvement size of child1/child2; gamma 0.5.
rl_ring_setspriority: Same per-pair D3QN segment choice as rl_ring_sets on Ring_SETSpriority (C4 PriorityEncoding); needs its own checkpoint.

Per-segment features: effective-difference buckets, inactive differences, span length, active ratio, the span's share of the worst target's neighbourhood cost and of total network cost (fitness v2's 0.7/0.3 terms), active energy; plus 7 shared features. Tiered reward per child: beats the pre-round best = 10, beats its parent = 1, else 0 (after DE-DDQN's R2).
